english.title: Disclose information obtained under Water Industry Act 1991 about business or individual without consent
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information which had been obtained by virtue of a provision of the Water Industry Act 1991 with respect to a business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..), and related to the affairs of

(A)_[an individual, namely **(..SPECIFY INDIVIDUAL..),]_
(B)_[a business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..),]_
(C)_[that business]_

(D)_[during the lifetime of the individual]_
(E)_[whilst the business continued to be carried on]_

and without the consent of

(F)_[that individual]_
(G)_[the person for the time being carrying on the business]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 206(1), (7) and (8) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
disclosed information with respect to a business
which had been obtained by virtue of a provision of the Water Industry Act 1991
and related to the affairs of an individual or to a business,
during the lifetime of the individual or whilst the business continued to be carried on
and without the consent of that individual or the person for the time being carrying on the business

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum
Indictment; Two years imprisonment and/or a fine

None
